name: Jake English vs. the Confession
source:
follow jake english on a quest to avoid an incoming confession from his best buddy, while he tries to escape his persistent splinters! will dirk get to confess his love? will jake win against the prince of heart's mind games?? read and find out!!!!!!

[From [url=https://www.tumblr.com/mezucore/780674389607907328/jake-english-vs-the-confession-a-dirkjake]Tumblr[/url]].

跟随Jake English展开一场冒险：他既要躲开好哥们即将说出口的告白，还要甩掉那几个纠缠不休的分身！Dirk能成功表白吗？Jake能在心灵王子的心理战里胜出吗？快读下去，看看结果吧！！！
